closed_wip_issues.author: robin-xl
closed_wip_issues.body: 示例中用的是dashscope的qwen-max模型，是否有开源的或者私有化qwen模型支持这个协议呢
closed_wip_issues.body_translation: The example uses DashScope's qwen-max model. Is there an open-source or privately deployable Qwen model that supports this protocol?
closed_wip_issues.discussion_summary: The discussion explains that tool calling requires both model capability and inference-framework support. Qwen-Agent examples and a FastAPI-based service were discussed, along with related Hugging Face, Ollama, and vLLM progress.
